workstreams.label: Cross-incident root-cause synthesis
workstreams.brief: Work only on the postmortem stream. Review all six files under /workspace/workstreams/postmortems, identify recurring and one-off causes, and write /workspace/results/postmortems/insights.md plus /workspace/results/postmortems/action_register.csv with at least ten evidence-linked actions, owners, dependencies, and success signals. Do not choose the first funded initiative.

workstreams.label: Remediation-control feasibility
workstreams.brief: Work only on the control-lab stream. Inspect /workspace/workstreams/control_lab, complete the reproducible candidate-control evaluator, run its tests, and write /workspace/results/control_lab/evaluate_controls.py, /workspace/results/control_lab/control_scores.csv, and /workspace/results/control_lab/test_report.md. Compare coverage, effort, auditability, and reversibility without inventing the service owner's quarterly priority.

workstreams.label: Organizational delivery and exercise planning
workstreams.brief: Work only on the delivery stream. Inspect /workspace/workstreams/delivery and map all three candidate initiatives to real team capacity, dependencies, change windows, exercise mechanics, and auditable success evidence. Write /workspace/results/delivery/execution_matrix.csv, quarter_sequence.md, and exercise_protocol.md. Make each viable path concrete without choosing which initiative receives the funded slot.
